name: Connected vertical timing, ramp and current-feedback output

vertical_trim.rationale: R22 original 100 kohm rheostat; initial midpoint setting, not a frequency calibration.

vertical_bf.rationale: Uncalibrated silicon NPN family gain, not measured 1SA20C curves.

sync_enabled.rationale: External bench sync amplitude multiplier; near-zero disables sync without altering the circuit.

sync_period.rationale: Synthetic field stimulus for lock characterization, not a captured firmware waveform.

sync_loss_start.rationale: Explicit external sync-loss interval for bench characterization; does not change oscillator circuitry.

sync_loss_end.rationale: Explicit external sync-loss interval for bench characterization; does not change oscillator circuitry.

height_trim.rationale: R35 22 kohm rheostat, midpoint by default; no specimen setting.

vertical_compensation.rationale: C15 capacitance unresolved in BOM; engineering sensitivity bound, NOT a factory value.

retrace_bf.rationale: KFY18 class proxy from Tesla 1987 catalog pages 222-223: h21e 50-250 at 1 mA/5 V and h21E 90-300 at 10 mA/10 V; BF is not a direct gain specification.

symmetry_fraction.rationale: R58 470 ohm potentiometer wiper fraction; specimen setting unknown.

linearity_r59.rationale: R59 documented 47 kohm rheostat; initial midpoint.

linearity_r60.rationale: R60 documented 47 kohm rheostat; initial midpoint.

yoke_vertical_r.rationale: Hypothetical vertical winding resistance, not a measured or factory value.

yoke_vertical_l.rationale: Hypothetical vertical winding inductance, not a measured or factory value.

output_bf.rationale: Class-typical complementary power BJT gain. ST BD139/BD140 Rev 5 page 4 gives hFE 40..250 at 150 mA and at least 25 at 5 mA or 500 mA; factory V27/V28 identities remain unresolved.

output_n_tf.rationale: NPN V27 forward transit time. Philips 1985 BD139/BD140 data book gives typical NPN fT 250 MHz at 50 mA, 5 V; 1/(2 pi fT) is about 0.64 ns before junction-capacitance effects. Broad 0.3..5 ns class-typical bound, not a factory V27 specification.

output_p_tf.rationale: PNP V28 forward transit time. Philips 1985 BD139/BD140 data book gives typical PNP fT 75 MHz at 50 mA, 5 V; 1/(2 pi fT) is about 2.1 ns before junction-capacitance effects. Broad 0.8..10 ns class-typical bound, not a factory V28 specification.

limitations: Connected vertical stage only; external ideal 12/+22/-16 V supplies and synthetic sync.
A3 uses manufacturer LM709 topology with assumed generic transistor parameters; not a verified P09A equivalent.

V27/V28 factory identities and yoke R/L unresolved. Handwritten page-10 BD140 by upper V27 and BD139 by lower V28 conflict with the modeled NPN/PNP polarity from the printed output stage; class-typical gains and transit times do not settle that conflict.
No converter, horizontal/flyback, heater, CRT load, thermal or SOA qualification.
